主要内容: On March 14, 2014, Optical Cable Corporation issued a press release announcing its first quarter of fiscal year 2014 financial results. The company also held an earnings call on the same date. The press release and transcript of the earnings call were attached as Exhibits 99.1 and 99.2, respectively. The report was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) as part of Form 8-K. The press release and earnings call transcript provide details on the company's financial performance for the quarter. The report was signed by Tracy G. Smith, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, on March 14, 2014.
